# Yahoo

> > Yahoo is a comprehensive digital media and information platform offering news, finance, sports, entertainment, weather, shopping, and search services with real-time market data and breaking news coverage.

Yahoo serves as a major hub for news aggregation, financial information, and entertainment content. The platform integrates multiple specialized verticals including Yahoo Finance for stock market data, Yahoo Sports for game scores and fantasy games, and Yahoo News for breaking news and trending stories. Yahoo also provides lifestyle, health, technology, and shopping content alongside its core search and email services.

## Core Platforms

- [Yahoo | Mail, Weather, Search, Politics, News, Finance, Sports & Videos](https://www.yahoo.com): Yahoo homepage aggregating mail, news, finance, sports, weather and entertainment
- [Yahoo News: Latest and Breaking News, Headlines, Live Updates, and More](https://www.yahoo.com/news): Yahoo News homepage with breaking news, headlines and live updates
- [Yahoo Search - Web Search](https://search.yahoo.com): Yahoo Search engine for web, images, videos and answers

## Finance & Markets

- [Yahoo Finance - Stock Market Live, Quotes, Business & Finance News](https://finance.yahoo.com): Yahoo Finance platform for stock quotes, market data and financial news

## Sports & Entertainment

- [Yahoo Sports: News, Scores, Video, Fantasy Games, Schedules & More - Yahoo Sports](https://sports.yahoo.com): Yahoo Sports hub featuring scores, fantasy games and sports news
- [Yahoo Entertainment](https://www.yahoo.com/entertainment): Yahoo Entertainment hub for TV, movies, music and celebrity news
- [Where to watch Fanatics Flag Football Classic: Channel, live stream, time, TV schedule for game with Tom Brady, more - Yahoo Sports](https://www.yahoo.com/sports/articles/where-watch-fanatics-flag-football-052001925.html): Sports guide for watching Fanatics Flag Football Classic with Tom Brady

## Lifestyle & Wellness

- [Yahoo Life: Latest News on Health, Wellness, Style, Fashion Trends and More](https://www.yahoo.com/lifestyle): Yahoo Life platform for style, wellness, fashion trends and lifestyle news
- [Yahoo Health: Advice and Reviews on Nutrition, Fitness, Sleep, Aging, Well Being and More](https://health.yahoo.com): Yahoo Health hub for wellness, nutrition, fitness and expert health advice
- [Yahoo Creators: A community of creative voices](https://creators.yahoo.com): Yahoo Creators community platform for lifestyle content and user-generated ideas

## Shopping, Weather & Technology

- [Yahoo Shopping: The Best Deals and Reviews on Clothing, Beauty, Home essentials, Tech and More](https://shopping.yahoo.com): Yahoo Shopping platform for deals, reviews and product recommendations
- [San Jose, CA Weather Forecast, Conditions, and Maps – Yahoo Weather](https://www.yahoo.com/news/weather): Yahoo Weather providing forecasts, conditions and maps for locations
- [Yahoo Tech | Technology News, Updates, Reviews & Stories](https://tech.yahoo.com): Yahoo Tech covering technology news, product reviews and AI updates

## News & Trending

- [Yahoo Trends 100](https://www.yahoo.com/trending): Real-time trending stories across news, entertainment and sports
- [Trump says no, but Americans expect boots on the ground in Iran: Poll](https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/65-americans-believe-trump-send-041008333.html): News article on Iran military deployment poll and Trump foreign policy
